transcript.text:
Hello everyone. I have one spare workbench in my garage that can be used for bicycle repairs, and I'm looking for someone to use it under the right terms. What I want in return is reliable access for a mechanic and two tune-ups for my own bicycles. I should mention up front that I keep Sundays reserved for family use, so the workbench won't be available that day.

If you're interested, let me know what you can offer. When we get to the final round, I'll have each interested person state their concrete offer aloud, I'll repeat the exact terms back, and then I'll make the final call about who may use the workbench and on what terms.
